{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-st54","title":"[review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: SCHC fragment decode reads payload from shifted wire data for ALL_1_FCN","description":"`rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:255` — `Fragment::from_bytes()` for `ALL_1_FCN` fragments reads the payload from the shifted wire buffer `data` instead of the unshifted `body` buffer:

```rust
payload: &data[2 + MIC_LENGTH..data.len() - 1],
```

Should be:
```rust
payload: &body[2 + MIC_LENGTH..2 + content_len],
```

The MIC is correctly read from `body` (unshifted, line 250), but payload is read from `data` (shifted). This causes data corruption on ALL_1_FCN fragments — the last fragment of every SCHC message, so all reassembled payloads from wire format would be corrupt.
